tiers.verified: primary documents or our own measured data

rules: every claim carries a dated verdict and a written flip condition
no payment ever changes a verdict
a 'dead' or 'no evidence' verdict describes the public evidence at the stated date, not an accusation of fraud

entries.claim: AI trading agents make retail users money
entries.flip: a vendor publishes a falsifiable live ledger showing net user outperformance after costs

entries.claim: Agents paying per-use (x402) is the next economy
entries.flip: sustained real (non-test) volume growth for two consecutive quarters; next recheck 2026-11

entries.claim: B.AI's crypto-settled model relay has 1.7M users
entries.flip: independently audited usage data from a named third party

entries.claim: AI-trading startups are the place to be (PandaAI wave)
entries.flip: any funded vendor publishing audited user-level returns

entries.claim: Small sites earn passive income from newsletter referral networks
entries.flip: a verified small-site case (<5k readers/mo) clearing $50/mo with its denominator published

entries.claim: Copying famous investors' 13F filings beats the market
entries.flip: the quarterly filing-day-close recompute flips a copied book across the index line

entries.claim: Faceless AI video channels are passive income
entries.flip: a platform policy reversal, or a verified post-2025 channel ledger with revenue and strikes shown

entries.claim: Small sites can earn passive income charging AI crawlers to read them (pay-per-crawl)
entries.flip: any small independent site publishing verified crawl-payment revenue above $50/month, or a major crawler operator publishing per-site payout data showing the same
